craft_notes: Sthāyin: offering all (sarva-samarpana). Sanskrit first: yat (whatever of four: vacaś/cetaś/kārya/śarīram) + mama + tvatprasādena (by YOUR grace, instrumental means) → bhūyāt (let it be) bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam (ornamented solely with devotion). Feel: catalogue of all one owns, then the single asking. Device: commas throughout, no dash — the offering is laid out flat, nothing held back. Rejected: 'decked' for 'trimmed' — killed: trim is plainer and keeps bhūṣaṇa's fitting-sense; dropping 'by grace' — killed: tvatprasādena is load-bearing means, restored as verb 'grace them'. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Word, wit, work, this frame of mine, Lord, grace them to gleam
l4.sanskrit_cite: vacaś cetaś ca kāryaṃ ca śarīraṃ mama yat prabho tvatprasādena tad bhūyād bhavadbhāvaikabhūṣaṇam

reads_against.argmap: Speech and mind and deed and my body — which, O lord.; By your grace may that be ornamented alone with devotion to you. → May speech, mind, deed, body be ornamented with devotion.
c1_essence: Word, wit, work, frame gleam with love alone.
reads_against.l2: Word and wit, work and this frame of mine, lord — grace them to gleam with love of you and nought beside.
l3: Word, wit, work, this frame of mine, Lord — by grace of thee
